# gtme show

Print the current-value projection for one identity.

## Forms

```
gtme show <identity-key> [--fields a,b] [--provenance]
gtme show --run RUN_ID|last [--fields a,b] [--provenance] [--limit N]
gtme show --run RUN_ID|last --pending [STEP]
```

| Form | Does |
|---|---|
| `gtme show <identity-key> [--fields a,b] [--provenance]` | print the current-value projection for one identity |
| `gtme show --run RUN_ID|last [--fields a,b] [--provenance] [--limit N]` | list the records a run touched |
| `gtme show --run RUN_ID|last --pending [STEP]` | the records awaiting a participant with the surface each is shown, as text on stderr and NDJSON on stdout — what an agent reads before it answers (ADR-049) |

## Flags

| Flag | Takes | Form | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fields` | `a,b` | `gtme show <identity-key> [--fields a,b] [--provenance]` | See the form. |
| `--provenance` | nothing | `gtme show <identity-key> [--fields a,b] [--provenance]` | See the form. |
| `--run` | `RUN_ID|last` | `gtme show --run RUN_ID|last [--fields a,b] [--provenance] [--limit N]` | See the form. |
| `--limit` | `N` | `gtme show --run RUN_ID|last [--fields a,b] [--provenance] [--limit N]` | See the form. |
| `--pending` | nothing | `gtme show --run RUN_ID|last --pending [STEP]` | See the form. |

## Exit codes

| Code | Means |
|---|---|
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | other error |
| 2 | validation or contract error: the plan, the file, or a value was refused |
| 3 | auth or credential error |
| 4 | rate-limited by a vendor |
| 5 | network error |

## Example

From [See it run](/start/show-me):

```sh
gtme show jane.doe@acme.com
```
